user.title: Choose the printer
user.description: Pick the printer device and the sensors below are filled in for you, along with any AMS slots the printer is currently reporting. Leave it empty to configure everything by hand. Nothing is committed here — the next screen shows what was found so you can correct it.

data_description.print_weight: The sensor whose attributes hold the per-slot filament weight for the current job.
data_description.cover_image: Optional. Captured and stored with each logged job.
data_description.camera_entity: Optional. With the Use-camera-snapshot switch on, each job's picture is a camera frame taken the moment the print finishes, instead of the slicer's render.
data_description.start_time: Optional. Only used to work out a job's duration when its start was never observed — a restart or an outage; normally the duration is measured live.

costs.title: Filament slots and rates
costs.description: Add one slot per filament source, using the exact attribute name from the print weight sensor — for example 'AMS 1 Tray 1'. Optionally add a label and a tray sensor after pipes: 'AMS 1 Tray 1|A1|sensor.printer_ams_tray_1'. The tray sensor supplies the colour and material for the job log, and its tag_uid prices the slot from the tag library. Leave empty if you do not use an AMS.

data_description.energy_sensors: Summed to work out the energy a print used. Usually the printer and AMS socket meters.
data_description.default_filament_price: Used for a slot with no price set, and for filament from an unconfigured source.
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Optional. Follows a variable tariff — point it at a sensor reporting the price per kWh (e.g. EUR/kWh). When set it overrides the fixed price below, which stays as the fallback for when the sensor is unavailable.
data_description.currency: Shown on the cost entities and in the cards. Any text works — EUR, USD, PLN, £.
data_description.power_sensors: Summed and multiplied by the price to give a live cost rate, which is integrated over time. This is what makes a variable tariff come out right, and it captures standby between prints. Usually the printer and AMS sockets.
data_description.auto_log: Each finished print is appended to the job log by the integration itself — no automation needed. Aborted prints are not logged.
data_description.filament_types: Used by the jobs table to shorten logged filament names to just the type, whatever brand precedes it. Add entries for types you use that are missing; leave empty to use the built-in Bambu lineup.
data_description.color_name_api: A scanned spool whose colour is not in Bambu's palette is named via the color-names web API (api.color.pizza) — one small request per new unknown spool. Off, or offline, the row says Unknown Color.

init.title: Re-scan from the device
init.description: Pick the printer device to fill the sensors and slots in again, or leave it empty to keep what is configured and just edit it.

sensors.description: Change which sensors this integration reads.

write_tags.name: Write tag library
write_tags.description: Replace the whole filament tag library. The previous file is kept as tags.csv.bak.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Bambu Print Costs entry is set up.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: List of tag objects: filament, color_code, color_name, serial, serial_2, cost_per_kg, disabled.

write_jobs.name: Write job log rows
write_jobs.description: Apply edits to logged jobs. Each row is matched to the file by the timestamp it was loaded with; the rest of the log is untouched. The previous file is kept as jobs.csv.bak.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Bambu Print Costs entry is set up.

rows.name: Rows
rows.description: List of edited rows in the job log sensor's shape, each carrying orig_ts — the timestamp the row had when it was read.

set_tag_price.name: Set tag price
set_tag_price.description: Update the price of every tag carrying a serial number.

log_job.name: Log job
log_job.description: Append the finished job to the log. Anything not supplied is read from the configured sensors.

job.name: Job name
job.description: Defaults to the job name sensor.

filament_type.name: Filament type
filament_type.description: Overrides the detected material list, e.g. PLA Basic, PETG HF.

add_job.name: Add job row
add_job.description: Append one explicit row to the job log — the failed-print form's save path. Reads no live state and never blocks the running job's own auto-log.

row.name: Row
row.description: The row, in the job_log sensor's field names (ts, job, mins, weight, trays, layers_done, status, …). A blank ts becomes now.

capture_cover.name: Capture cover
capture_cover.description: With no cover on the row, store the slicer's render as its picture.

update_totals.name: Update totals
update_totals.description: Add the row's filament weight and cost to the lifetime totals, exactly as the row carries them.

draft_job.name: Draft job
draft_job.description: Returns a pre-filled row for logging a print by hand — the current print, or the last one when the printer is idle. Backs both the failed-print and add-finished-print forms. Read-only.

capture_cover.name: Capture cover photo
capture_cover.description: Take a camera photo now and store it as a job cover. Returns the filename and URL.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: The job row's timestamp — names the file, so a retake overwrites.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-read the CSV files from disk.

import_legacy.name: Import legacy CSV
import_legacy.description: Bring tags and job history in from the pre-integration CSV files. Paths must be inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.

tags_path.name: Tags CSV
tags_path.description: Path to the old filament tag CSV, e.g. /config/www/bambu_tags.csv.

jobs_path.name: Jobs CSV
jobs_path.description: Path to the old job log CSV, e.g. /config/www/bambu_jobs_log.csv.

covers_path.name: Covers folder
covers_path.description: Folder holding the job cover images referenced by the job log.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Wipe existing data first. Off by default, which merges and skips duplicates.

sync_slot_prices.name: Sync slot prices
sync_slot_prices.description: Copy the loaded spool's tag price into each slot's price number. Runs automatically when a print starts.
